what: Audit of every published derived count in rruleref -- a count computed by a classifier of mine over a score, as distinct from a score itself. Rule 79, applied retroactively after finding 071 discovered by accident that finding 070's '123 unattributed' does not reproduce.
question_asked_of_each: Is the derivation -- the classifier, not only its output -- saved somewhere a later reader could run or read?

enumeration.method: Two mechanical passes over findings/*.md and conformance/RESULTS.md, then manual triage of the hits. Pass 1: lines matching '<n> of <n>' or '<n> are|remain|fall|split|account'. Pass 2: files containing 'unattributed|residual|unexplained|attribut'. A finding was triaged out when its numbers were scores (recomputable from score.py plus a cases_id, rule 77), corpus-structure counts emitted by committed code in src/, qualitative tables, or test assertions.
enumeration.limits: This enumeration is textual. A derived count phrased in a way neither pass matches would have been missed. The audit does not claim completeness; it claims that everything it did find has been given a verdict.
